title: Glimpse of Vietnam South to North
alt: My Khe beach and the Da Nang skyline at dusk
transport: Two domestic flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon and the Mekong
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Saigon half day city tour
activities.match: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Mekong Delta full day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Two nights in District 1 with the city on arrival and a full day in the Mekong Delta.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Cu Chi, Da Nang and Ba Na
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels in a small group
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day Tour - Small Group
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of Saigon in a small group, with the trapdoors and the kitchens, before the flight to the coast.

activities.name: Cam Thanh basket boat trip
activities.match: Half Day Cam Thanh Basket Boat Trip
activities.description: A round bamboo basket boat spun through the water coconut palms at Cam Thanh, with the rowers showing off in the creeks.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills Full Day Tour From Da Nang
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The tunnels on the way out of the south, then three nights on the central coast with Cam Thanh and Ba Na Hills.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Halong Bay
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Hanoi half day city tour
activities.description: The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the lanes of the old quarter with a guide.

activities.name: Halong Bay full day dragon cruise
activities.match: Halong Bay Full Day Dragon Cruise
activities.description: A full day out on the bay aboard a dragon boat, through the limestone islands and the floating villages, back in Hanoi by evening.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: North for the last two nights, with a guided half day of the capital and a full day out on Halong Bay.

day_titles.3: Cu Chi and on to Da Nang

1: Arrival at Tan Son Nhat and transfer to your hotel
A half day of the city with a guide
The palace, the cathedral and the war remnants museum
Check in and the evening free
2: Breakfast, then south into the delta
A boat through the coconut creeks at My Tho
A sampan ride under the palms
The coconut candy workshops, then back to the city
3: Breakfast, then north west to Cu Chi
The tunnels in a small group with a guide
The flight to Da Nang in the afternoon
Check in near the beach, evening free
4: Breakfast, then out to Cam Thanh
A basket boat spun through the water palms
The creeks and the rowers at work
5: Breakfast, then the cable car up to Ba Na
The bridge held up by two stone hands
The French village and the gardens at the top
Back down to Da Nang in the evening
6: Breakfast and check out, then the flight north
A guided half day of Hanoi
The mausoleum and the Temple of Literature
Check in and the evening free in the lanes
7: Early breakfast, then east towards the coast
A full day on the bay aboard a dragon boat
The limestone islands and the floating villages
Back in Hanoi in the evening
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: South to north with three nights in the middle on the coast, which is where most people wish they had more time.
expert.tip: The basket boats at Cam Thanh look like a gimmick and are the most fun half day on this itinerary.

summary: Eight days south to north: two nights in Saigon with the city and a Mekong Delta day, the Cu Chi tunnels on the way out, three nights on the central coast with Cam Thanh basket boats and Ba Na Hills, then two in Hanoi with a city tour and a full day cruise on Halong Bay.
included: Included: 7 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the central and northern hotels; two domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a half day Saigon city tour; a full day Mekong Delta tour; a small group Cu Chi tunnels tour; a half day Cam Thanh basket boat trip; a full day at Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge; a Hanoi city tour; a full day dragon boat cruise on Halong Bay.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
